aka.en: Chongqing–Kunming Expressway (the name until the 2013 plan extended it north)
aka.zh: 渝昆高速（2013 年规划向北延伸前的名称）
成渝高速公路（重庆至内江段）

tagline.en: A Chongqing–Kunming road stretched north to Yinchuan on paper in 2013, then built over the Qinling and the Micang Mountains to match
tagline.zh: 原本的渝昆高速，2013 年在规划图上向北延伸到银川，随后翻秦岭、穿米仓山一路修通

start.en: Majinpu interchange with the Kunming–Mohan expressway, Chenggong District, Kunming, Yunnan — the terminus since 2017
start.zh: 云南省昆明市呈贡区马金铺立交，接昆磨高速——2017 年以来的终点

end.en: Binhe New Area toll station, Xingqing District, Yinchuan, Ningxia, on provincial road S203
end.zh: 宁夏回族自治区银川市兴庆区滨河新区收费站，接 203 省道

en: G85 is one of the north–south lines of the national expressway network, running through six provincial-level regions. From Yinchuan it goes south past Lingwu and the Taiyangshan development zone, down the length of southern Ningxia by Tongxin and Pengyang, into Gansu at Pingliang and Huating, and into Shaanxi at Long county. It drops to Baoji on the Wei River, crosses the Qinling to Hanzhong, and goes under the Micang Mountains into Sichuan at Nanjiang, then by Bazhong and Guang'an to Chongqing. From there it follows the old Chengdu–Chongqing expressway west to Neijiang, turns south by Yibin and Shuifu into Yunnan, and climbs by Zhaotong, Huize and Songming to Kunming.

Its length is variously given. The Ningxia transport department and Xinhua put it at 2,322 km when it was completed in 2024; English Wikipedia gives 2,332 km and Chinese Wikipedia 2,123 km. Between Longchang and Neijiang it shares its carriageway with G76 Xiamen–Chengdu.
zh: G85 是国家高速公路网的南北纵线之一，途经六个省级行政区。它从银川向南，经灵武、太阳山开发区，经同心、彭阳纵贯宁夏南部，在平凉、华亭进入甘肃，在陇县进入陕西；下到渭河边的宝鸡，翻越秦岭至汉中，再从米仓山下穿过，在南江进入四川，经巴中、广安至重庆。此后沿老成渝高速西行至内江，南折经宜宾、水富进入云南，经昭通、会泽、嵩明爬升至昆明。
全长说法不一。宁夏回族自治区交通运输厅和新华社在 2024 年全线贯通时称全长 2,322 公里；英文维基百科作 2,332 公里，中文维基百科作 2,123 公里。隆昌至内江段与 G76 厦蓉高速共线。

en: The two great obstacles are mountain ranges, and both are crossed in tunnel. Baoji–Pingkan, 73.2 km of six-lane road for 80 km/h, climbs the north face of the Qinling and goes through the main ridge in the 15.56 km Tiantaishan tunnel, part of a 32 km group of ten tunnels and five bridges that is 98.1% structure; the whole section is 72% bridge and tunnel. It was the fifth expressway across the Qinling in Shaanxi.

Further south the Micangshan tunnel, 13.8 km, 3 km of it in Shaanxi and 10.8 km in Sichuan, carries the road between the two provinces. At its holing-through in August 2018 Xinhua described it as the longest expressway tunnel open in south-west China and the second longest in the country, with the longest single-heading drive of any road tunnel in China, about 8 km from the exit end, and a ventilation shaft 432 m deep. The Bazhong–Shaanxi border section it belongs to is 78.2% bridge and tunnel.

Smaller works are notable too. Qianyang–Qianhekou passes the Fengjiashan reservoir protection area on four tall continuous rigid-frame bridges; one of them, the Wulipo bridge, is 172 m high and has been called the highest bridge in north-west China. In Yunnan, the Zhaotong–Maliuwan, Zhaotong–Huize and Gongshan–Daibu stretches were first built in the 2000s as class-II roads and later rebuilt, or bypassed by new expressway; Chinese Wikipedia puts the whole Yunnan section at expressway standard from 2015.
zh: 两大障碍都是山脉，都以隧道穿越。宝坪段全长 73.2 公里，双向六车道，设计时速 80 公里，沿秦岭北坡展线爬升，以 15.56 公里的秦岭天台山特长隧道穿过主脊；该隧道所在的隧道群总长 32 公里，由 10 座隧道和 5 座桥梁组成，桥隧比 98.1%；全段桥隧比 72%。它是陕西第五条穿越秦岭的高速公路。
再往南，13.8 公里的米仓山隧道连接川陕两省，其中陕西境 3 公里、四川境 10.8 公里。2018 年 8 月贯通时，新华社称它是当时已贯通的西南最长、全国第二长的高速公路隧道，出口端独头掘进约 8 公里，为国内公路隧道之最，中部竖井深 432 米。它所在的巴陕高速全线桥隧比 78.2%。
较小的工程也有可观之处。千阳至千河口段途经冯家山水源保护区，建有 4 座高墩大跨径连续刚构桥，其中五里坡特大桥高 172 米，被称为「西北第一高桥」。云南境内，昭通至麻柳湾、昭通至会泽、功山至待补等路段 2000 年代先按二级公路修建，后来或改扩建、或另选线新建高速公路；据中文维基百科，云南段于 2015 年实现全程高速化。

en: The southern half is old. The Chengdu–Chongqing expressway, Sichuan's first, was begun in September 1990 and opened in 1995; Kunming–Songming opened in 1996, Neijiang–Yibin in December 1999 and Yibin–Shuifu on 17 November 2006. Under the earlier national expressway plan this was G85, the Chongqing–Kunming expressway. The 2013–2030 national plan, approved by the State Council in May 2013, extended it north to Yinchuan; under the Ministry of Transport's renumbering rules the number stayed G85 and only the name changed, to Yinchuan–Kunming. Chongqing began re-signing its section in December 2017 and finished in 2019; Sichuan began re-signing its roads in April 2019.

The extension was built in the decade that followed. In Shaanxi, Qianyang–Huoshaozhai opened on 26 October 2010, Hanzhong–Sichuan border on 2 September 2015, Pingkan–Hanzhong on 28 December 2017 and Baoji–Pingkan on 30 September 2021, a year early, completing G85 in Shaanxi. In Sichuan and Chongqing, the Bazhong–Guang'an–Chongqing road opened throughout on 20 August 2017, and Bazhong–Shaanxi, with the Micangshan tunnel, on 22 November 2018, cutting Bazhong to Hanzhong from three and a half hours to one. In 2017 the Kunming end was also moved, from the Xiaozhuang interchange on the Second Ring Road to Majinpu in Chenggong.
The last gap was in Ningxia. The 237 km Taiyangshan–Pengyang section, begun in August 2020, opened at 15:00 on 16 August 2024, and Xinhua reported the whole route complete.
zh: 南半段历史较久。成渝高速是四川第一条高速公路，1990 年 9 月开工，1995 年通车；昆明至嵩明段 1996 年、内宜高速 1999 年 12 月、宜水高速 2006 年 11 月 17 日相继通车。在此前的国家高速公路网规划中，这条线是 G85 重庆—昆明高速。2013 年 5 月国务院批准的《国家公路网规划（2013—2030 年）》将其起点向北延伸至银川；按交通运输部的命名编号调整原则，编号仍为 G85，只把名称由「渝昆高速」改为「银昆高速」。重庆自 2017 年 12 月启动标志更换，2019 年完成；四川于 2019 年 4 月起调整全省高速公路编号标志。

延伸段在此后十年间修通。陕西境内，千阳至火烧寨段 2010 年 10 月 26 日通车，汉中至陕川界段 2015 年 9 月 2 日，坪坎至汉中段 2017 年 12 月 28 日，宝鸡至坪坎段 2021 年 9 月 30 日提前一年通车，银昆线陕西段全线贯通。川渝境内，巴广渝高速 2017 年 8 月 20 日全线通车；含米仓山隧道的巴陕高速 2018 年 11 月 22 日全线通车，巴中至汉中车程由三个半小时缩短为一小时。2017 年，昆明一端的终点也由二环小庄立交改到呈贡马金铺立交。
最后的缺口在宁夏。237 公里的太阳山至彭阳段 2020 年 8 月开工，2024 年 8 月 16 日 15 时通车试运营，新华社报道银昆高速全线贯通。

en: No total has been published. The newest sections are also the most expensive. Taiyangshan–Pengyang cost ¥26.1 billion, the largest single road project in Ningxia's history, and was built as a public–private partnership by a consortium of ten companies led by China Railway Construction Corporation and Ningxia Construction Group. Baoji–Pingkan was budgeted at ¥12.9 billion, of which ¥3.5 billion went on the Tiantaishan tunnel; Bazhong–Shaanxi at ¥14.7 billion.

For Baoji–Pingkan the National Development and Reform Commission's approval of December 2015 sets out the financing: an estimate of ¥13.464 billion, with ¥3.418 billion from the central vehicle-purchase-tax fund and ¥1.295 billion of the project company's own funds as capital — about 35% — and the rest from domestic bank loans.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。最新修的路段也最贵。太阳山至彭阳段总投资 261 亿元，是宁夏迄今单体投资规模最大的公路项目，由中国铁建股份有限公司、宁夏建工集团有限公司等 10 家公司组成联合体，以 PPP 模式投资建设。宝坪段概算 129 亿元，其中天台山隧道 35 亿元；巴陕段概算 147 亿元。
宝坪段的资金构成见于国家发展改革委 2015 年 12 月的批复：估算总投资 134.64 亿元，其中中央车购税专项资金 34.18 亿元、项目法人自有资金 12.95 亿元，共 47.13 亿元作为资本金，约占 35%，其余利用国内银行贷款。

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. G85 was built by six provincial-level regions as separately financed sections between 1990 and 2024; sourced section costs are listed below.
why.zh: 未公布全线总造价。G85 由六个省级行政区在 1990 至 2024 年间分段筹资建设；有来源的分段造价列于下方。

value.en: Partial: Taiyangshan–Pengyang as a public–private partnership of ten companies led by China Railway Construction Corporation and Ningxia Construction Group; Baoji–Pingkan with ¥3.418 billion central vehicle-purchase-tax money and ¥1.295 billion from the project company as capital, the rest bank loans. Funding of the older sections has not been found.
value.zh: 部分可查：太阳山至彭阳段由中国铁建、宁夏建工等 10 家公司组成联合体以 PPP 模式投资；宝坪段资本金为中央车购税专项资金 34.18 亿元和项目法人自有资金 12.95 亿元，其余为银行贷款。较早路段的出资方未查到。

timeline.en: Work on the Chengdu–Chongqing expressway begins in September.

timeline.zh: 四川第一条高速公路成渝高速通车。

timeline.en: Yibin–Shuifu opens on 17 November, linking Sichuan to the Yunnan section.
timeline.zh: 11 月 17 日，宜水高速通车，四川段与云南段相接。

timeline.en: The national plan approved in May extends G85 north to Yinchuan; the name changes from Chongqing–Kunming to Yinchuan–Kunming, the number stays.
timeline.zh: 5 月批准的国家公路网规划将 G85 向北延伸至银川，名称由渝昆高速改为银昆高速，编号不变。
9 月 2 日，汉中至陕川界段通车。

timeline.en: Bazhong–Guang'an–Chongqing opens throughout on 20 August; Pingkan–Hanzhong opens on 28 December; the Kunming terminus moves to Majinpu.
timeline.zh: 8 月 20 日，巴广渝高速全线通车；12 月 28 日，坪汉高速通车；昆明终点改至马金铺立交。

timeline.en: Bazhong–Shaanxi opens on 22 November with the 13.8 km Micangshan tunnel.
timeline.zh: 11 月 22 日，巴陕高速连同 13.8 公里的米仓山隧道全线通车。

timeline.en: Chongqing and Sichuan finish re-signing their sections as G85 Yinchuan–Kunming.
timeline.zh: 重庆、四川完成路段标志更换，统一为 G85 银昆高速。

timeline.en: Work on Taiyangshan–Pengyang in Ningxia begins in August.
timeline.zh: 8 月，宁夏太阳山至彭阳段开工。

timeline.en: Baoji–Pingkan opens on 30 September, completing the route in Shaanxi.
timeline.zh: 9 月 30 日，宝坪高速通车，银昆线陕西段全线贯通。

timeline.en: Taiyangshan–Pengyang opens on 16 August, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 8 月 16 日，太阳山至彭阳段通车，银昆高速全线贯通。
